name: Syncro
description: Syncro lets agents read and update tickets, customers, assets, and invoices in the Syncro PSA and RMM account. Each user signs in to their own Syncro account through the browser.

prompts.text: Which open tickets have had no update for three days?
List the assets for the customer Acme Dental and their last check-in.
Draft a note on the printer ticket that summarizes the steps taken so far.

apps.name: Syncro
apps.description: Ticket, customer, asset, and invoice access, over Syncro's MCP server with browser sign-in.
